candidate_relations.reason: The reference diagnosis is 'lipoma' and the candidate specifies 'lipoma of breast.' The clinical record describes a well-defined, encapsulated, fat-signal mass (T1/T2 hyperintense, fat-suppressed, no internal vascularity) in the retromammary/pectoralis region of the left breast, fully consistent with a lipoma. Adding the anatomical site 'of breast' is a harmless, clinically appropriate specification rather than an incompatible subtype.
